description: How much fertilizer to put on your lawn: pounds of product per 1,000 sq ft and for the whole lawn, from the nitrogen rate you want and the N-P-K numbers on the bag, plus bags to buy and the phosphate and potash you apply along with it. Formula: Product per 1,000 sq ft = N rate ÷ (N% ÷ 100). Total = product per 1,000 × area ÷ 1,000. Bags = total ÷ bag weight, rounded up. P₂O₅ (or K₂O) per 1,000 = product per 1,000 × P% (or K%) ÷ 100.

n_lb_per_1000.description: Nitrogen rate wanted (lb N per 1,000 sq ft); default 1

n_pct.description: Nitrogen % (first number on the bag); default 24

name: calc_lawn_fertilizer
title: Lawn Fertilizer Calculator (Pounds per 1,000 Sq Ft from N-P-K)
